item.name: Grand Teton Scenic Float - Private Tour
item.unicode: Grand Teton Scenic Float - Private Tour
item.booking_notes:
#What's Included
- central meeting point
- transportation to river put-in
- life jacket for each person (USCG certified)
- professional guide
- small group tour: 12 guests per boat, maximum
- small cooler with ice

#What to Bring
- layered clothing (for warmth)
- refillable water bottle
- soft-soled shoes
- sunglasses / hat
- sunscreen
- personal items (lip balm, medications like epi, inhaler, etc.)
- camera (optional)
- binoculars (optional)
- rain jacket
- small daypack
- any food or beverage items you wish to enjoy while you float

##What to Wear
Make sure to dress in layers that are appropriate for the weather conditions on the day of your tour.  Our days can start out cool and end up warm in the summer months, and the mountain weather is always variable, so come prepared with layers you can add or remove as needed to keep yourself comfortable.  Be sure to pack your rain jacket in your daypack, just in case.  

#Before Arrival
Please take time to [read our waiver](https://grand-teton-scenic-floats.com/risk-agreement/)  that you will be required to sign prior to departure.

*A Reminder: Please take time to review the cancellation policy.  Due to limited seating, we strictly adhere to the stated policy.*

###Join Us
**Get Social**
Follow us on [Instagram](https://www.instagram.com/solitudejh/) for a sneak peek on what to expect on a scenic float with Solitude Float Trips.

**Meet the Team**
We know how important our guides are to the quality of our scenic floats.  [Our team](https://grand-teton-scenic-floats.com/float-trip-preparation/about-us/) has been hand-picked for their in-depth knowledge of the river, and the premium service they provide on each and every tour.


- - -

#Explore More
If you are looking for more to do in the area, our trusted partner and sister company, [Jackson Hole Wildlife Safaris](https://jacksonholewildlifesafaris.com/), offers half day and full day tours into *Grand Teton National Park* and *Yellowstone National Park*.  A wildlife safari with a knowledgeable guide can enhance your time in the region and provide an entertaining and educational experience for your friends and family.  

###Guest Favorites
**Half Day Wildlife Safari**
This half day tour is a great introduction to Grand Teton National Park, the perfect way to fill a morning or afternoon in Jackson Hole.
[Learn More >>>](https://jacksonholewildlifesafaris.com/summer-safaris/half-day-wildlife-safari/)

**Grand Teton Wildlife Safari**
This full day tour is spent exploring Grand Teton National Park in search of wildlife, local history, and stunning alpine landscapes.
[Learn More >>>](https://jacksonholewildlifesafaris.com/summer-safaris/grand-teton-safari/)

**Best of Yellowstone**
This full day tour takes you to the world's first national park, with notable highlights such as Old Faithful Geyser and Grand Prismatic Spring.
[Learn More >>>](https://jacksonholewildlifesafaris.com/summer-safaris/yellowstone-safari/)

primary_location.name: Solitude Float Trips - Meeting Location
primary_location.note:
**Please use this GPS link for directions to our meeting location.**

[**Meeting Location**](https://maps.app.goo.gl/sqKi2mv7gcnVokEaA)

**Driving Directions**
From the town of Jackson >>>
Drive north on Cache Street, which will become highway US-191 North, for approximately 12 miles.  4 miles past the turn-off for the Jackson Hole Airport, make a left turn at Moose Junction; this is Teton Park Road.  Proceed 0.5 miles and cross the bridge over the Snake River.  As soon as you cross the bridge, turn right at the 4-way stop into the designated float trip parking area.  Look for a white van with the company name, "Solitude Float Trips".

**Please arrive 10-15 minutes before the stated launch time and be ready and waiting at the Float Trip Meeting Point (look for the sign on the sidewalk in front of the bathrooms).**
